customSections.label: Which CCS Calendar Should You Use?
customSections.content: Most CCS students follow the Traditional Calendar. Early College programs and the district’s Restart schools use separate calendars, so confirm the student’s school or program before planning around these dates.

definitions.description: Use the Traditional Academic Calendar shown on this page.
The Early College calendar starts August 12, ends May 13, and schedules graduation May 15 at West Cabarrus High School.

Concord Middle School, Rocky River Elementary, Royal Oaks, W.M. Irvin Elementary, and Winecoff Elementary use the Restart Calendar, which adds early dismissals on September 4, February 5, and March 5.

definitions.description: Students do not attend on either type of workday; the distinction applies to staff scheduling.

The Traditional Calendar schedules early dismissal at the end of each quarter. High school exams fall within separate December and May exam windows. Restart schools also have three additional early-dismissal dates.
High school exams are scheduled for December 14–18, May 20–21, and May 24–26. The May dates are not one continuous range.
Traditional high school graduations are May 26–28 at Cabarrus Arena & Events Center. Individual schools publish ceremony times and senior instructions.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: School starts one day later than in 2025–26 — August 12 instead of August 11.
The last day falls six days later — May 26 instead of May 20.
The Traditional Calendar schedules 174 instructional days, one fewer than in 2025–26.

sourceReviewSummary: Sources include the official Traditional, Early College, and Restart calendars published by Cabarrus County Schools.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the CCS calendars
sourceReviewDetails: The Traditional Calendar was checked for the first and last day, breaks, student no-school workdays, early dismissals, exam windows, graduation, and its published instructional-day and hour totals.
The separate Early College and Restart PDFs were reviewed so this page does not apply Traditional Calendar dates to every CCS student.
The downloadable .ics file includes the verified Traditional Calendar dates shown on this page and does not update automatically after import.
